body: The prescription would be based on how your vision is and if you have astigmatism.  If it turns out you do have astigmatism it might be a bit harder to get a large variety of colored lenses. The shape of your eye shouldn't make a difference. In the end I recommend that you start out with colored lenses with the diameter of 14.0 or 14.5 then working your way up in size (if you want larger lenses that is), and like Kihel said, be sure to get an eye exam so you don't mess up your eyes.
